blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate on Monday approved on third and final reading three measures seeking to strengthen regional cooperation against transnational crimes, improve tourist safety, and provide free housing through usufruct arrangements. First approved was Proposed Senate Resolution No. 623, or the resolution concurring in the ratification of the Association on Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Treaty on Extradition. The measure was approved with 20 affirmative votes, zero negative votes and zero abstentions.
